nodes.label: Next.js 16 App Router Pattern
nodes.rationale: Pages under src/app/[locale]/ stay thin — they read params, fetch, then delegate to modules. This keeps routing infrastructure separate from feature logic.

nodes.label: Feature Module Convention
nodes.rationale: Modules under src/modules/<feature>/ separate domain/types, app/hooks/server, infrastructure/api, and presentation/components. Prevents mixing business logic with UI.

nodes.label: i18n Dual-Locale System (en/ar)
nodes.rationale: en.ts is the source of truth. Dictionary type derived via DeepWiden. ar.ts overrides partial keys; missing keys fall back to en via deep merge. RTL handled via isRtl() + html dir attribute.

nodes.label: Localized Routing Model
nodes.rationale: All routes under src/app/[locale]/. Locale prefix injected by middleware. Hrefs built with getLocalizedRoute() + ROUTES constant — never hardcoded — to prevent broken links across locales.

nodes.label: Auth Cookie Strategy (token + mwafq-session)
nodes.rationale: token is httpOnly:false so client http can attach Bearer. mwafq-session is httpOnly:true for security. Both set together on login, cleared on logout. Proxy treats either presence as authenticated.

nodes.label: Client-Server Data Flow Pattern
nodes.rationale: Client calls local app/api routes via http wrapper (auto-attaches Bearer). Server services call upstream productionapi.mwafq.com directly. Separates client-facing API surface from upstream integration.

nodes.label: Tailwind + Framer Motion Styling Rule
nodes.rationale: Tailwind for all UI chrome. Framer Motion for all animation. No CSS modules for ordinary chrome. ScrollReveal shared component for reveal-on-view patterns to avoid duplication.

nodes.label: RTL (Arabic) Logical Utility Rule
nodes.rationale: Use logical Tailwind utilities (ps-*, pe-*, ms-*, me-*, start-*, end-*) instead of directional ones (pl-*, pr-*, left-*, right-*) so layout works in both LTR and RTL without duplication.

nodes.label: Mwafq Brand Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Brand colors (#1e2364 sapphire, #00a8f1 accent sky, #6b7196 muted) used as hex arbitrary values in Tailwind. No theme config yet. shadcn uses OKLCH tokens — do not mix the two systems in one component.

nodes.label: Two-Library Component Strategy
nodes.rationale: Custom shared components (@/shared/components/ui) for brand product UI. shadcn primitives (@/components/ui) for primitives not in shared set. Never mix button systems in one component.

nodes.label: ScrollReveal Shared Animation Component
nodes.rationale: Centralizes intersection-observer reveal + window.load-delay + reduced-motion support. Prevents duplication of reveal logic across feature components.

nodes.label: Server-Only / Client Boundary Rule
nodes.rationale: Server files start with import 'server-only'. Client components use 'use client'. Files shared between both use *.shared.ts naming and no server-only imports.

nodes.label: Architecture-Over-Brevity Priority
nodes.rationale: When conflict occurs between clean architecture and shorter code, architecture wins. Prevents short-term shortcuts that break modularity or create technical debt.
